title: Add Pagination to My Files, Shared, Trash, and Recent Sections

requirements.text: Create a reusable Pagination component that renders: a user-selectable items-per-page dropdown (options: 10, 25, 50, 100) defaulting to 10; page number buttons; Previous and Next buttons; First and Last page shortcut buttons; a total items and total pages display; and a current range indicator (e.g., 'Showing 21-40 of 356 items'). The selected items-per-page value must NOT be persisted and resets to 10 each time the page or section is loaded.

quotes: Display a limited number of items per page (e.g., 10, 25, 50, 100 items per page)
First and Last page shortcut buttons
Display total number of items and total pages
reset to the default each time

acceptanceCriteria: Pagination component renders items-per-page dropdown with options 10, 25, 50, 100
Default items-per-page is 10 on every fresh load
Items-per-page selection is not persisted to localStorage or sessionStorage
Page number buttons show the correct range of pages
Previous, Next, First, and Last buttons are present and functional
First and Last buttons are disabled when already on the first or last page respectively
Previous button is disabled on the first page; Next button is disabled on the last page
Range indicator displays correctly (e.g., 'Showing 1-10 of 45 items')
Total items count and total pages count are displayed

requirements.text: Apply the reusable Pagination component to the My Files section (Dashboard page and FileList component). All file and folder entries in the current view must be paginated using the shared component.
acceptanceCriteria: My Files section shows at most the selected items-per-page count of entries at a time
Pagination controls appear below the file and folder list
Navigating pages correctly slices the displayed items
Changing items-per-page resets to page 1

requirements.text: Apply the reusable Pagination component to the Shared section, covering both the Shared With Me and Shared By Me sub-sections independently. Each sub-section maintains its own pagination state.

quotes: Shared section (Shared With Me / Shared By Me)

acceptanceCriteria: Shared With Me sub-section has its own independent pagination controls
Shared By Me sub-section has its own independent pagination controls
Each sub-section resets to page 1 when items-per-page is changed
Range indicator is accurate per sub-section

requirements.text: Apply the reusable Pagination component to the Trash section, covering both the Files and Folders tabs independently. Each tab maintains its own pagination state.
acceptanceCriteria: Trash Files tab has its own independent pagination controls
Trash Folders tab has its own independent pagination controls
Switching tabs does not carry over the page number from the other tab
Bulk select operations work correctly with paginated views

requirements.text: Apply the reusable Pagination component to the Recent section (Recent page). All recently uploaded file entries must be paginated using the shared component.
acceptanceCriteria: Recent section shows at most the selected items-per-page count of entries at a time
Pagination controls appear below the recent files list
Navigating pages correctly slices the displayed items
Changing items-per-page resets to page 1

constraints: Default items-per-page must be 10 and must NOT be persisted across sessions or page refreshes — it resets every time.
Do not modify any files listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
All pagination is purely client-side; do not change backend query signatures or add backend pagination parameters.
nonGoals: Persisting the selected items-per-page value in localStorage, sessionStorage, or any other storage
Adding pagination to any section not listed such as the Home dashboard or Admin Dashboard
Changing the backend data model or API
